shortDescription: Manages configuration of an PIM static RP address instance.

options.name: bidir
options.description: Group range is treated in PIM bidirectional mode.

options.name: group_list
options.description: Group range for static RP. Valid values are multicast addresses.

options.name: prefix_list
options.description: Prefix list policy for static RP. Valid values are prefix-list policy names.

options.name: route_map
options.description: Route map policy for static RP. Valid values are route-map policy names.

options.name: rp_address
options.description: Configures a Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) static rendezvous point (RP) address. Valid values are unicast addresses.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.
